The main takeaway from our work is that

holographic superconducting films are a very good toy model for superconducting systems in general, and that the DC and AC conductivity of the superconductive phase are in good agreement with the Ginzburg-Ladau theory, even for temperatures very close to the critical temperature.
the presence of a direct current in the superconducting film has a dramatic impact on the superconducting properties.
